en: Look, the rails have gaps!
Lazy workers! They didn't finish the job.
No! The gaps are on purpose.
On purpose? Why?
In summer, iron gets longer.
Without a gap, the rail bends!
And the gaps make the train go tak-tak.
So the lazy one was me!

en: The waves are huge! We'll sink!
Hold on tight!
Don't be scared! I have oil.
Oil? On the sea?
Old sailors poured oil on the waves.
The waves stopped breaking!
A thin layer of oil calms the water.
Wait... that's my mother's cooking oil!
